findings.failure_path: On a passing carrier, prepend ordinary prose and U+2028 to the last registered opener, then replace the line breaks between that opener and its body lines with U+2028, keeping the LF before its closer. Python reconstructs the same registered block. CommonMark sees one prose line followed by a bare fence opener where the scanner sees the old closer. A shell line added immediately after that marker is real fenced content, but the checker ignores it and returns 0 with the original inventory.
findings.smallest_fix: Split only on LF after Python's universal-newline normalization already handles CR and CRLF. Add a regression using U+2028 and correct the register's coverage claim against the verified behavior.

findings.failure_path: Under default Bash pipeline semantics, layout_case runs in a subshell and its ok or bad counter update is lost. A regression affecting only the tab-heading case can print FAIL while the suite exits 0. The reported increase from 78 to 84 is one short of the seven net new assertions, and N1 and N2 each fail other cases that mask the lost result.
findings.smallest_fix: Pass the tab fixture through input redirection to a direct layout_case call. Verify that breaking only this fixture makes the top-level suite exit 1, then refresh the counts and mutation record.

findings.failure_path: The frozen packet omits the unchanged carrier or a source-located inventory and provides only summaries for the control and N1–N6 runs. This leaves both the 12-block compatibility result and the claimed per-mutant failure attribution unverified.
findings.smallest_fix: Attach the candidate-bound 12-block inventory and the exact mutation edits, exit statuses, and failing-assertion output for the control and N1–N6.

findings.failure_path: The supplied validation records the focused suite and structural checks. It supplies no candidate-bound result for make test or the heavy regression lane required by the root AGENTS.md for this shared-skill checker change.
findings.smallest_fix: Record the exact commands and results for both required runs against the landing candidate, including any blocked or skipped checks.

skipped_clients.reason: claude belongs to the implementer model family

concern_results.conclusion: Python's splitlines() can preserve all 12 extracted blocks while CommonMark sees an unregistered fence. The inline-span control covers the three supplied forms.

The delta adds no network, credential, permission, or durable-write path. The inventory mismatch can cause the suite to execute text that Markdown presents as prose while omitting a rendered runnable block.
Recognized layout errors return 1 before manifest processing. The tab-heading fixture runs in a pipeline subshell, so its failure can be lost when the suite computes its exit status.

The fixtures exercise the reported container cases and inline-span control. They omit the line-boundary mismatch, and N1 and N2 fail other assertions even when the tab-only failure cannot fail the suite. The packet contains summaries of the mutation runs.

The delta adds no flags, dependencies, rollout switches, or manual steps. It intentionally rejects more carrier layouts. Compatibility with the unchanged carrier remains unverified from the supplied artifacts.
The change introduces no persisted state or migration. Reverting the delta restores the prior scanner, fixtures, and diagnostics. Rollout still needs a candidate-bound check of the unchanged carrier.
Layout diagnostics provide source excerpts and line locators, but Unicode separators can shift those locators. A tab-heading failure can also appear in the log alongside a successful suite summary.

The append-only row supersedes the prior keep decision, withdraws the unsupported stdlib attribution, and records the need, alternative, blast radius, and pre-fix RED. Its claim that every real opener is inventoried or rejected is false.

The shared gate can return success with an unchanged inventory even when a real runnable fence is omitted. The reported mutation set does not test agreement between the scanner's line boundaries and CommonMark's.

The scanner bypass violates the directory's exhaustive-manifest rule, and the tab fixture violates its fail-closed assertion rule. The packet also lacks results for the root contract's full local lane and heavy regression run.
